prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1403; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the claimant in connection with the rear-end collision that occurred involving your insured. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical treatment. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, in writing, or in person.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the policy declarations page, including the applicable bodily injury and property damage liability limits, along with any other coverage that may apply to this loss. Please also confirm whether any excess or umbrella policies exist for your insured.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes claim files, photographs, recorded statements, telematics or vehicle data, repair estimates, adjuster notes, and any other materials in your possession or control. Destruction or alteration of such evidence may result in sanctions.

We look forward to your prompt written response confirming receipt of this letter and your acknowledgment of these requests.
